kind: FIRST independent actual-image scientific and visual V verdict; inactive candidate only
goalBodyDe: Die lernende Person kann ausgewählte Bindungs- und Wechselwirkungstypen zwischen Farbstoff-Molekülen und Faser-Molekülen beschreiben und die Eignung von Farbstoffen als Textilfarbstoff beurteilen.
goalTitleEn: Evaluate textile dyes through dye-fiber interactions
goalBodyEn: The learner can describe selected bonding and interaction types between dye molecules and fiber molecules and evaluate the suitability of dyes as textile dyes.
contentAssessment: No gross chemical blocker identified at native and desktop size. Selected-example framing removes the old universal fastness ladder. Schematic ionic wool contact, cellulose O-C fixation and neutral polyester uptake are consistent with the two exact cases; these are conceptual models, not complete structures or a reaction mechanism.

blockingIssues.observation: The three fiber objects and large captions remain recognizable. The NH3+/SO3- group notation, especially the charge superscripts, and the Reaktivfarbstoff/Dispersionsfarbstoff qualifiers shrink to very small text and cannot be comfortably read at the actual phone width. The cellulose O-C motif and red covalent contact are also substantially harder to discriminate than at 680 px.
blockingIssues.scientificConsequence: The dye-class qualifiers and charge signs carry the distinctions that make these specific systems valid. The phone view cannot rely on reading that small text to establish opposite charge versus covalent attachment or the selected reactive/disperse dye restriction.
blockingIssues.requiredCorrection: Enlarge the scientifically important charge/group notation and dye-class labels, or simplify the composition so these distinctions remain readable at 360 px. Retain selected-example framing and avoid any universal fastness ranking. Re-view the corrected exact PNG at native, 360 and 680 px before approval.

positiveFindings: Native and desktop charge signs on wool are NH3+ and SO3-, with dashed rather than covalent contacts.
The cotton panel contains a solid Cell-O-C(dye) contact; it is a schematic product motif without a complete valence or reaction-equation claim.
Neutral dye blobs lie between polyester chains and use dashed noncovalent contacts; no new ionic or covalent polyester bond is depicted.
Equal panels, the selected-example title and Farbstoff + Faser + Bedingungen avoid a universal suitability or wash-fastness ranking.
Friendly hand-drawn contours and warm colored panels fit the approachable image language. No visible ID, watermark, logo, lab-execution claim or copied worksheet layout.
bounds: Generation, hash matches and desktop legibility are not approval. This FIRST does not authorize active import, D/P/A/M rebinding, human approval, deployment or full M7 completion.
